items.stem: A student writes: take cup, add tea, add milk, seal, add pearls, serve. The robot stops at step 5. Why?

options.text: The robot has no instruction for adding pearls.
options.feedback: Add pearls is one of the seven instructions. The order of the steps caused the stop.

options.text: The cup was sealed at step 4, so nothing can be added.
options.feedback: Order matters. The pearls had to go in before the seal.

options.text: The list has too many steps for the robot.
options.feedback: The robot can follow a list of this length. Step 4 closed the cup too early.

items.stem: A program makes drinks with "repeat 6 times." On a busy afternoon the queue has 9 orders. What happens?

options.text: The robot makes all 9, because it checks the queue.
options.feedback: The count is fixed at 6, so the robot stops after six drinks whatever the queue holds.

options.text: The robot makes 6 drinks and 3 half-made drinks.
options.feedback: Each pass makes a complete drink. The robot stops after pass 6.

options.text: Three orders wait, because the program stops after 6.
options.feedback: A fixed count ignores the real queue. 9 minus 6 leaves 3 orders waiting.

items.try: Choose 6 times, press Add order three times, then press Run queue.

items.stem: The café wants the robot to make every order, whatever the length of the queue. Which rule gives that behavior?

options.text: Repeat the steps until the queue is empty.
options.feedback: The stop rule follows the real queue, so it works for a queue of any length.
A queue of 12 leaves two orders waiting, and a queue of 5 makes five cups for nobody.

options.text: Repeat forever, with no stopping rule.
options.feedback: A loop with no stopping rule keeps making drinks after the last order.

items.stem: An AI assistant is asked to "make the form better." It changes the colors, and the team wanted fewer fields. What would have prevented this?

options.text: A longer chat that thanks the assistant after each answer.
options.feedback: Polite words do not make an instruction exact.

options.text: An exact instruction, such as "keep only name, email and phone."
options.feedback: Exact steps leave the reader nothing to guess, whether the reader is a robot or an AI assistant.

options.text: Asking the same request three times in a row.
options.feedback: Repeating a vague request gives three vague answers.
